_AppTime_Note: Business timezone for ALL timestamps (audit fields, transaction dates, document numbers, report 'today'). Pinned so behaviour never depends on the hosting server's clock. Accepts IANA (Asia/Karachi) or Windows (Pakistan Standard Time) ids.
_ConnectionStrings_Note: Do NOT commit real connection strings here. Provide them per-environment via appsettings.Development.json (git-ignored), environment variables, or user-secrets. For production use 'Encrypt=True;TrustServerCertificate=False' with a valid certificate.
_PlatformAdmin_Note: Required on first boot only (when no platform super-admin exists yet). Do NOT commit real credentials — set via user-secrets or environment variables (PlatformAdmin__Email / PlatformAdmin__Password).
